imageLayout.pick: struggle cycles 1-2-3 every 4s; game over picks a random 1-3

struggleArt: Ikiela in player-ref silver crop armor, bare midriff, katana still sheathed or dropped as they work her ribs and soles.
gameOverArt: Same woman, red bikini, wrecked laugh, imperial street behind her.
beats: Fingers find the midriff gap in the silver.
Bare feet kick — then get caught.

struggle: The drone-zombie crowds in, green fingers skating her ribs.
She bites a laugh. The crop armor leaves too much skin.
They go for the soles — she tries to twist the katana free.
gameover: Ikiela drops, red bikini, still giggling as the drone nestles in.

struggle: Vines cinch her ankles to the street.
Creepers slip under the silver plates.
The trap tickles up her calves like it has a grudge.
gameover: The vines keep her posed in a red bikini until the laugh wins.

struggle: Four hands: two on her waist, two hunting armpits.
She slashes air. They just swap grips.
A spare pair works her toes.
gameover: Quad-Arm sits her down in the red bikini and does not stop.

struggle: The bolter slams her into a lantern post.
Fast fingers, no technique — just speed.
She can't get a full breath between laughs.
gameover: Too fast. Red bikini. The city keeps moving without her.

struggle: Hands everywhere. There is no safe plate.
They find every gap in the silver crop.
Soles, ribs, neck — a chorus of tickles.
gameover: A hundred hands peel her down to the red bikini and finish the job.

struggle: The tongue tags her navel first.
Then the arch of her foot.
She hates how precise it is.
gameover: Licker leaves her in the red bikini, still twitching.

struggle: Egg-web snaps across her chest and hips. The spider never touches her.
Tiny black spiders pour out of the silk.
They map every inch of bare midriff.
gameover: Webbed in a red bikini, covered in a moving black glitter of spiders.

struggle: The web hits and traps. Not a body-grab — silk and swarm.
Hundreds of tiny black spiders fan out.
They tickle like a live cloak.
gameover: She loses the laugh-war inside a red-bikini cocoon of silk.

struggle: Slime slaps across the silver and stays warm.
It creeps under the plates.
Every wriggle makes it tickle more.
gameover: Slimed, red bikini, still trying not to smile.

struggle: The shot paints her midriff.
It pulses. It tickles.
She can't wipe it off mid-run.
gameover: The slime decides the match. Red bikini. Street lanterns smear.

struggle: Bolo wraps her ankles mid-stride.
She hops once — then they have her feet.
Toe-by-toe work. Unfair.
gameover: Ankles still bound. Red bikini. The archer does not rush.

struggle: Leather kisses both ankles.
Then the tickle starts at the soles.
She can't jump. She can only mash free.
gameover: Wrapped, laughing, red bikini against wet imperial stone.

struggle: The volatile hugs like a collapse.
Tickle pressure is a whole-body buzz.
She has seconds, not minutes.
gameover: Overwhelmed. Red bikini. The laugh is the last thing standing.

struggle: The brute just lifts her.
One huge palm spans her ribs.
The other works both feet at once.
gameover: Pinned in a red bikini against a shrine gate.

struggle: A thrown hand catches her waist.
It crawls with awful enthusiasm.
She slaps at it and laughs anyway.
gameover: Too many hands. Red bikini. The thrower jogs past, already winding up another.

struggle: The hand latches and kneads.
It knows the midriff gap.
It will not let go until she mashes it off.
gameover: One hand was enough. Red bikini on the cobbles.
